adapters.current_reference_naive: Protocol last-record-per-key baseline, not actual RunAWay compressor performance.
adapters.new_reference_codec: Protocol event-preserving reference codec, not a measured LLM compressor.

limitations: Shared finite event grammar and protocol reader; this calibrates scorer sensitivity, not model generalization.
Dev/eval parameter combinations and history templates are disjoint, but share the event ontology.
Published fixtures are development data for future model comparisons.
No single quality/token ratio; missing output stays in all planned denominators.
